entities.name: Rhonas's Monument
entities.description: A revered artifact and holy site on Amonkhet shaped like a cobra head, where initiates face the Trial of Strength.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: Snake-headed god of strength to whom the monument is devoted; he reveals the poison to initiates and bestows the cartouche of strength.

entities.name: Trial of Strength
entities.description: Ordeal of the monument testing power, instincts and survival skills.

entities.name: Stairs of Rhonas
entities.description: Ropes of living vines hanging from the open roof that initiates climb.

entities.name: Statues of the Highest
entities.description: Statues depicting legendary initiates from past crops.

entities.name: Fertile Holding
entities.description: Complex where initiates make their final stay before completing training.

entities.name: basilisk
entities.description: Color-shifting basilisk whose scale is the cure for the poison.

events.summary: Initiates climb the Stairs of Rhonas and leap down the waterfall into the jungle.
events.quote: a climb up the treacherous Stairs of Rhonas , followed by a leap of faith to ride the thundering waterfall down into the jungle below

events.summary: Rhonas appears to reveal that poison from the thorny vines runs through the initiates' veins, stripping their magic and clear thought.
events.quote: Rhonas appears to reveal that poison now runs through their veins

events.summary: Initiates must claim a scale from the basilisk as a cure, then return to Rhonas, who bestows the cartouche of strength.
events.quote: The final test demands that the initiate claim a single scale from the basilisk

relations.quote: devoted to the snake-headed god Rhonas
a revered artifact and holy site on the plane of Amonkhet
